fields.label: Crop
fields.description: The crop this rate applies to. Leave blank for every crop.

fields.label: Determinant
fields.description: Water: the rate is per an amount of spray water (a Volume unit). Hectarage (shown as Area): per an amount of land (an Area unit).

fields.label: Per
fields.description: The amount in the denominator, e.g. 1, 100 or 1000. Blank reads as the legacy unit (1000 for Water, 1 for Area).

fields.label: Per UOM
fields.description: Volume UOM for Water, Area UOM for Hectarage. Must convert to Litre or Square Meter.
